summary: Make R19 live swapchain destruction transactional so failed GPU-drain proof or xrDestroySwapchain failure preserves the existing RTV/image vectors and swapchain metadata for a later retry instead of discarding still-owned resources.

C0_RECOVER.evidence: Recovered exact HEAD 22aee739d5927205cc0113afa6cfe0bc4c6b80aa. CONVERSION-DX9EX-00456 passed DX9Ex Active Validation 37407755821 and Domain Isolation Guard 37407755818. Structural extraction remains terminal.

C1_REVIEW.evidence: Swapchain::Destroy released every RTV and cleared images before proving GPU completion or xrDestroySwapchain success. Its live fail-closed returns therefore retained the OpenXR handle/metadata but discarded the local D3D11 resource set, weakening retry/recovery semantics after a transient drain or destroy failure.

C2_IMPLEMENT.evidence: Moved RTV/image release and metadata reset after both live failure returns. Parent-session teardown retains its existing child-cleanup delegation and then clears local state.

C3_VALIDATE.evidence: Retry exact SHA passed DX9Ex Active Validation and Domain Isolation; initial failure was verifier-only.

red_review.missing_contract: The live fail-closed paths returned after rtvs/images had already been released/cleared, so a failed recreate attempt could not preserve the still-owned local swapchain resource set for retry.

references: OpenXR 1.1.63 requires all submitted graphics commands referring to a swapchain to complete before xrDestroySwapchain.

Microsoft D3D11 documents deferred destruction of views/resources and explicit completion/flush behavior; retaining local references until ownership resolves keeps the live failure path transactional.

runtime.reason: No Quest3/VDXR or in-game HMD session was performed.

initial_failed_gate.reason: require_order used source.find for duplicate return false markers, so the second live-destroy failure return could not be uniquely ordered.

retry_repair.verifier_change: Split destroy result-path retention assertion from global order checks to avoid duplicate-token false negatives.

next_action: Continue from the latest exact HEAD with the next independently provable DX9Ex stability/resource-lifetime unit; preserve b855fd32389aa330b8f04598fbcd76853c6d8f99 as CONVERSION-DX9EX-00457 validation-bearing result.
